description: Which surveying firms represent ratepayers in business rates appeals. Returns the 12-month league of firms at the Valuation Tribunals for England and Wales (cases, attended, won, win rate, typical reduction, councils, latest decision, website), or the firms matching a name. With an area (postcode or council) it also returns the firms that represented ratepayers at the tribunal there in the same 12 months, and rating firms from our directory with an office within 50 km (firm, size, nearest office, distance, website). Firms only; no individual is named. BusinessRateChecker does not recommend or endorse any firm. Costs 1 credit.

ba_code.description: Council (billing authority) code, e.g. '5390'. Alternative to council.

council.description: Council name or part of it, e.g. 'Hammersmith' or 'Leeds'. Use instead of postcode for a whole council.

firm.description: A firm's name or part of it, e.g. 'Knight Frank'.

include.description: Optional extra sections for the answer. The ones available are listed in the response under settings.include_supported; anything else is ignored and listed in settings.ignored. Leave out unless the user asks for something the normal answer lacks.

limit.description: Rows for the area lists and firm matches, 1 to 25 (default 10).

options.description: Optional extra settings by name. The ones available are listed in the response under settings.options_supported; anything else is ignored and listed in settings.ignored.

postcode.description: A full postcode ('W6 8DR'), a postcode sector ('W6 8') or a district ('W6').

name: find_rating_surveyors
title: Find rating surveyors
